findings.why: The sentence states the set-but-unusable arm as the class of any tool that allocates through `strict_scratch_root()`, but at C0 env-diff's own documented `--contract` mode raises `ScratchRootUnusable` outside its `--selftest` catch — traceback, exit 1, no could-not-evaluate line (receipt T54W1Read01-receipts/nonself-envdiff.err) — while the note it cites (corpus/knowledge/scratch-root-contract.md:51-53) and the round-54 contract's C2 `cannot_see` limit the measured class to the self-test path, so the rule is false as stated outside that unstated scope.
